data.notes: October 2026 is anchored by Tbilisi’s heavyweight electronic institutions—4GB, Bassiani, KHIDI and queer-led parties—while hip-hop and bass nights broaden the travel-worthy calendar.

events.title: Bassiani 12
events.summary: Bassiani marks its 12th anniversary with a marathon across Bassiani and Horoom featuring Rødhåd, MARRØN, Truncate, µ-Ziq live, Cassy, Ryan Elliott, Lawrence, Lowtec & Kassem Mosse, DJ Sodeyama, Erika and many more.

events.title: 4GB Festival 2026
events.summary: 4GB returns to Loco Park for a multi-day electronic festival with Miss Kittin, Perc, DJ Sotofett, Ivan Smagghe, IMOGEN, Map.ache, Boyd Schidt, Tomma, Vakho, Zurkin and many more.

events.title: Wings of Desire: 8th Biannual Queer Gathering
events.summary: Bassiani’s biannual queer gathering takes over Bassiani, Horoom and Aarmass with a large multidisciplinary lineup including 2CIU, Creams & Liza Rivs, HerShey, Knaughty, Memotech, Sophie Phare and many more.

events.title: Tbilisi Hip-Hop Festival
events.summary: The inaugural Tbilisi Hip-Hop Festival brings Talib Kweli and FLOHIO to Factory Tbilisi, with beat battles, Red Bull Dance Your Style, graffiti, film screenings and hip-hop culture programming.

events.title: Bassiani – Horoom: The Advent, Josey Rebelle, Samuel Kerridge
events.summary: Bassiani hosts The Advent, HVL, Cypher, Josey Rebelle and Samuel Kerridge live, while Horoom features Dito, MESH, Ulf Eriksson and Vakho.

events.title: Bassiani – Horoom: Anthony Rother, Virginia, Gonno, Hasvat Informant
events.summary: Anthony Rother performs a hybrid electro set at Bassiani alongside Hasvat Informant, Nikala, 3AM, Beka Wu live and Thomas Hessler b2b Ina Kacz; Horoom hosts Gonno, Edge, Tomma and Virginia.

events.title: Curated By Resident: Kancheli
events.summary: Bassiani resident Kancheli curates a two-room night with Kancheli b2b Jessie Granqvist, Dorisburg live, Thanos Hana live, Albert van Abbe, Eric Cloutier, Hamatsuki, Kdema, Kvanchi and TaronX.

events.title: KHIDI: Ancient Methods, Alexandra, Demuja, Sevda
events.summary: KHIDI hosts an all-night-long main-room set from Ancient Methods, while G2 features Alexandra, Demuja and Sevda across house, dub, techno and progressive trance/house.

events.title: Eau De Cologne
events.summary: Bassiani’s queer sex-positive party Eau De Cologne returns with Citizens Union, Kiddy Smile, Natuta and Vince, with the event framed around inclusivity, consent and expressive dress code.

events.title: KHIDI Halloween Night: Curses, Parrish Smith, Natalie Beridze
events.summary: KHIDI’s Halloween night features Curses, Parrish Smith, Carmilla Sioux and Natalie Beridze, with the venue highlighting new wave, Italo disco, EBM, punk, rock, techno and experimental electronics.

events.title: KHIDI: David Vunk, Pablo Bozzi, Puritan, Saphileaum
events.summary: KHIDI welcomes Pablo Bozzi and David Vunk on the main stage with residents Puritan and Saphileaum; G2 hosts Boyd Schidt, Frequency Shifter, Ketato M and Vnjoka.

events.title: Carbon Based Lifeforms - Tbilisi
events.summary: Swedish psy-ambient duo Carbon Based Lifeforms perform at Elektrowerk, presenting the 20th anniversary of World of Sleepers alongside later material and a new unreleased composition.

events.title: KHIDI Halloween: Carmilla Sioux, Curses, Downwell, Natalie Beridze, Parrish Smith
events.summary: KHIDI’s Halloween night leans into dark-wave, EBM, electro, experimental electronics and techno with Carmilla Sioux, Curses, Downwell, Natalie Beridze live and Parrish Smith, plus a G2 room from Body Pressure, Leü and Sevda b2b Ash Scholem.

events.title: Horoom: DJ Sense, Obri, Seqta, Trotsky b2b Mtvare
events.summary: Bassiani’s Horoom room hosts a local-heavy night with DJ Sense, Obri, Seqta and a Trotsky b2b Mtvare set focused on trance, acid house, techno, electro and breaks.

events.title: Blue Balls: Meat-Packer
events.summary: Blue Balls brings its Meat-Packer edition to Cafe-Gallery with Mtvare, Leü and Magrra, leaning into house and electro with a queer club-night sensibility.

events.title: Mtkvarze 14th Anniversary
events.summary: Mtkvarze marks its 14th anniversary across main and small rooms with Kraumur b2b Tevz, Zurkin b2b DJ Astrobee, Tomma b2b Nika J and Rene b2b Parna.

events.title: HELHEIM 3rd F2F Edition
events.summary: HELHEIM’s third face-to-face edition takes over Revolution Club near Baratashvili Bridge with a long hard-techno, industrial, schranz and hardcore lineup.

events.title: MADLOBASS
events.summary: MADLOBASS returns to Spaceroom with Granul, The Machete Boyz, irrationalizard, 2rNick, Goka and RafDog for a deep-bass, dubstep, grime, jungle and UK-garage-leaning night.

events.title: The VIII Tbilisi International Piano Competition
events.venueName: Vano Sarajishvili Tbilisi State Conservatoire Grand Hall
events.summary: The quadrennial Tbilisi International Piano Competition is confirmed for October 5–16, 2026 in Tbilisi. The public competition features four rounds for young pianists, with finalists performing concertos with symphony orchestra and prize winners taking part in a gala concert.

events.title: Sing & Smile – A Choir Festival-Contest in Georgia
events.summary: Fiestalonia’s Sing & Smile choir festival-contest is confirmed for October 20–25, 2026 in Tbilisi, with competition performances, awards, and choral performances in Georgian church settings. Categories include vocal ensembles, adult choirs, world sacred music, folklore, pop, jazz, gospel, and academic singing.

events.title: Fiestalonia Georgia
events.summary: Fiestalonia Georgia is confirmed for October 20–23, 2026 in Tbilisi as an international festival-contest supported by the Mayor of Tbilisi. Its performance categories include instrumental groups, singing, jazz singing, rock/rap, folk singing, pop singing, and dance.

events.title: International Festival "Rhythms of Fall"
events.summary: The EAFF-listed International Festival "Rhythms of Fall" is confirmed for October 22–26, 2026 with Tbilisi, Georgia listed as the festival location. The program is a folklore-focused arts festival with dance, choirs/songs, and live or recorded music performances.

events.title: International Festival "Art-Folk Fest" (Autumn Edition)
events.summary: The autumn edition of Art-Folk Fest is confirmed for October 29–November 2, 2026 in Tbilisi. The EAFF member festival presents folklore dances, folklore songs, songs and romances, and a final concluding concert by participating artists.
